classification.difficultyReason: Identify the radius and use the subject variable and square-root sign to select one of the four semicircle orientations.

content.prompt: Sketch the graph of the following.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}r^2&=16\\r&=4\end{align*}$$
The positive square root gives $y\geq0$. Sketch the upper half of $x^2+y^2=16$, passing through $(-4,0)$, $(0,4)$ and $(4,0)$.
